intro_film.disclosure: AI-generated footage · Generated using SI tools
intro_film.disclosure_placement: Persistent HTML strip above the intact 3 × 2 frame. Embedded credits, including Generated using SI tools, are preserved with a legible HTML credit line.
intro_film.likeness_and_branding: Adult-appearing figures in sampled frames. Individual consent, identity, and asset rights are unverified. No NASA insignia was observed in the sampled frames.
intro_film.audio_video_playback: One inline video syncs the embedded soundtrack and image in a native loop. The initial markup requests audible autoplay. A policy-blocked start retries silently, with Enable Sound for a user-initiated start or unmute.

providers: NASA POWER / GPM IMERG and MERRA-2
data.method_reference: Source and methods in the handoff and the site evidence panel.
data.hypothetical_values: Classroom settings and model sensitivities are documented as illustrative. No new observation was generated.

integration.etl: The inherited Node build reads frozen NASA archives, matches the inherited Tuku evidence and bundles the verified data fingerprint.
integration.gis: The inherited map uses Natural Earth geometry and data-native NASA archive layers.
integration.github_pages: Static deployment files contain the supplied film and six JPEG story covers. Hosting and publication checks are pending.
integration.hardware: No hardware integration or farm validation was performed in this release.

hero_animation.origin: ChatGPT-assisted vector drawing and native SVG animation
hero_animation.classification: Schematic time-lapse illustration. The orbits are projected and no location or live ephemeris is used.
hero_animation.moon_phase_cycle_reset: Two-day repeat. The last hidden arc rejoins the first moonrise phase.
hero_animation.default_playback: Starts and repeats on opening. The caption allows manual pause and resume. The timeline runs in SVG independently of page scripts or styles.

story_cover_images.origin: Six conceptual illustrations supplied by the creator with embedded GPT Image credits.
story_cover_images.purpose: Illustrate the six stories. The mission data and scientific evidence are stored separately.
story_cover_images.disclosure_placement: Embedded in the lower-right area of each original. Preserved in the JPEGs and shown in full in the story viewer.
story_cover_images.conversion: The five artwork-archive covers use progressive JPEG at quality 92 with 4:4:4 sampling. The replacement Tuku cover uses the supplied JPEG bytes.
story_cover_images.deployment_and_deck_reuse: Website integration requested by the creator. Verify applicable permissions for any public deck reuse.
